source_level_learning_coverage.coverage_scope: All settled teacher responses at capture time, including a current batch whose update is still pending; operation inventory uses completed updates only.
source_level_learning_coverage.interpretation: Every completed batch parent supplies a grade to the fixed trigger selection. Only the recorded cohort is directly supplied as full source/feedback to its teacher; these are distinct coverage measures. Current-skill citations are declarations, not proof of independent semantic learning or successful reuse.
